integrity: Exact mathematical proof and reproducible finite exhaustive certificate; external priority and independent correctness audit remain outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for finite undirected independent-bond transmission, one perfect vertex removal and uniform post-vaccination seed; the tail is at least three infected vertices, and the two-class census covers connected graphs of exactly five vertices. No general SIR equivalence or empirical implementation claim.
title: Five vertices are sharp for disagreement between mean-outbreak and three-case-risk vaccination
